lemmas.primary_translation: to treat very carefully (to avoid problems)

definitions.text: behandle svært forsiktig (for å unngå problemer)
definitions.translation: to treat very carefully (to avoid problems) (lit. treat like a rotten egg)

examples.no: han måtte behandles som et råttent egg og ble aldri fornøyd
examples.en: he had to be treated like a rotten egg and was never satisfied
